body:
I have never written an experience report before, but in all my time (what might seem short to some but is in fact rather a long a fruitful relationship since age 14) of using stimulants and psychoactives in general, this warranted a report. If it matters, I live in the UK.
I wake up at 11.40am.
Mindset: Positive and excited as I knew my product was arriving. Just woke up fairly early and had about 8 hours sleep (normally, due to med conditions, I sleep 12+ hours).
Setting: Bedroom (in bed). Mum is awake downstairs and she is aware of my drug use although not the specifics. She is also a dope smoker herself so I am comfortable although I don't want her to see me on anything other than dope as it makes her uncomfortable (protective instinct bless her!). Brother is in the room next to me. Again, he is aware of my use of psychoactives and is accepting although doesn't like smoking around him. Mum's carer also arrives which caused slight anxiety due to his ignorance and unintentional bigotry from previous experience. I avoid downstairs.
12.00: Received 1g of MPA through the post. The chemical came as a white fluffy HCL powder. A slight sweet smell was present and has a VERY bitter taste.
A slight sweet smell was present and has a VERY bitter taste.
Due to this, I will not attempt a gum rub, sublingual or buccal ROA.
12.20: Insufflated (snorted) a 30mg line to start off. I felt a slight rush although this was probably psychosomatic because of anticipation. After a minute or two, I started rolling a spliff (joint).
12.30: At the end of rolling, I had this beautiful head rush very similar to that of Amphetamine but with a much faster come up. I then developed a moderate numbing over my entire body. Heart beat increased but only slightly (from my usual healthy 60bpm to 70bpm). Decided music was a good idea so started to listening to Gong. (a band).
12.30-50: I smoked a spliff containing a relatively small amount of dope (Cannabis Indica) as I've been smoking a long time and am affected by small amounts. Normally I would smoke a small amount of a spliff and then put it out and relight and repeat over 40mins or so. This time a spliff could be smoked in 10 mins if I lost control.
13.00: Remaining effects are at a low. I decide to insufflate a 25mg line. This time, the rushing come up kicks in in 5 minutes. The effects at this point have a similar rushing effect to amphetamine. A moderate euphoria and an all over body high. Gurning and teeth grinding is present but is typical for me as I already grind my teeth and stimulants always make that worse. A strange mix of saliva fluid changes. One minute my mouth is dry, the next minute I'm salivating quite a lot. Heart rate has increased again but not by much. From my last count of 70bpm to 80bpm however there is a feeling of slight chest tightening/weight but is not unpleasant.
13.40: Overall, this is a very exciting and interesting drug. I always used to be a bit snobby and mistrusting of RC's because I had tried others in the past which had some very unpleasant effects, but since experimenting with my recent first (which was BK-2-CB) they have come to surprise me. That being said, I have been buying from a reputable source and the quality of the chemicals is very high (at least a 98% standard).
In conclusion, one of the nicest stimulants known to me both physically and psychologically. Very forgiving and friendly. Experienced next to no negative effects, no pupil dilation and an overall clean stimulant. After effects last longer than reported for me. It is now 14.30pm and effects are still present.
